readings.Aries: The last time you did this, you learned something. Apply it now. The first instinct was right.
readings.Taurus: The loyalty you extend to others is real. It occasionally extends past the point of useful. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Gemini: The connection you're afraid of losing is already changing. Let it become what it needs to become. The first instinct was right.
readings.Cancer: The person asking too much of you knows they're asking too much. That doesn't mean they'll stop without a signal. The first instinct was right.
readings.Leo: What you create when no one is watching is your most honest work. Create some of that today. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Virgo: Someone around you needs your discernment, not your discretion. Share what you see. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Libra: You are so good at seeing others' perspectives that you have temporarily misplaced your own. Find it. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Scorpio: Something is moving beneath the surface. You can feel it. Trust the feeling. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Sagittarius: The future you're planning for is being built in the choices you're making now. Check the alignment. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Capricorn: Your relationship with time is complex. You are either far ahead of it or burdened by its passage. Today: present tense. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Aquarius: There is a feeling underneath the analysis that the analysis is a way of not feeling. Set the analysis down briefly. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Pisces: The dream you had — not the sleeping one — hasn't been attended to in some time. Return to it. The energy available today is better used gently.

sky_notes: Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
Waxing gibbous: more than half lit and growing. The Moon is also moving ~3.8 cm further from Earth every year — budget accordingly.
Mars and Jupiter are within 1.3° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
